item.title: Chips, Permits and People: What Citi's TMT Leadership Summit Revealed About the AI Buildout
item.description: At Citi's fifth annual TMT Leadership Summit (technology, media and telecom) in Pebble Beach, California, few speakers questioned demand for AI. Most of the talk was about what stands in the way of meeting it. The three-day program ran 21 sessions for almost 116 guests from outside Citi, representing nearly 103 companies worth about $12 trillion combined. The week also brought a sharp market selloff and a U.S. election.

item.title: Custody+ and the Future of Market Intelligence
item.description: Accelerated settlement cycles, continuous trading models, digital assets and AI are reshaping the post-trade landscape. Clients increasingly need faster access to information, greater transparency and more flexibility in how they consume custody services.

item.title: The Global Economy’s Tenuous Balance: Resilience Amid Uncertainty
item.description: The global economy is still powering ahead even as uncertainties — from the sustainability of the AI boom to geopolitics — continue to mount. We see global growth coming in at 2.7% this year and climbing to 2.8% next year, as pressures from the U.S.-Iran conflict eventually moderate. A new Citi Research report explores these uncertainties alongside the global economy’s sources of strength.

item.description: As trading volumes and assets under management across the APAC ETF ecosystem reach record levels, market participants have progressively shifted from legacy manual workflows to automated digital primary order portals.

FX in a Real-Time World: Building The Future Of Currency Execution
item.description: For most institutional clients, FX is not where returns are made. It is the mechanism that lets everything else work: settling a trade, hedging an exposure, repatriating a dividend. That executional role has not changed. What has changed is how clients expect it to be delivered.

item.title: Are Your SSIs in Place?
item.description: Lack of inventory, be it securities or cash, may be the biggest trigger for settlement fails, but data quality issues, such as inaccurate, missing or outdated Standing Settlement Instructions (SSIs) are a significant factor too.

item.title: Unlocking the Data Center Supercycle with Trade Finance
item.description: The rapid expansion of AI, cloud computing and digital infrastructure is driving a multi-trillion-dollar data center buildout, with Citi Research projecting $2.9 trillion in AI-related capital expenditure by 2030. Read more.

item.title: The Dual Ascent: A Founder's Guide to Scaling Your Company and Building Your Wealth
item.description: Whether you're a new founder or on your third startup, it is always good to have support as you maneuver through the above. This playbook is that invaluable resource, helping you excel along the two intertwining journeys you embark on the moment you close a major funding round: that of your business and your own. We created this playbook to be your go-to resource for the questions that arise on both paths, from corporate cash management to personal tax strategies.

item.title: Global Resilience Sunshine Despite Very Cloudy Skies
item.description: A new Citi Research report looks at our “global resilience” narrative, which has stayed firmly intact as the global economy's production side has grown more flexible and adaptable and AI spending has emerged as a robust engine of growth. Our 2026 global-growth forecast is now tracking at 2.6%, and we see it firming next year to 2.8%.

item.title: Exploring On-Behalf-Of Payment Models
item.description: As corporate treasurers continue to navigate the complexities of global payments and liquidity management, many are turning to advanced structures to build the treasury of the future.

item.title: Digital Collateral: A Practical Reality
item.description: Collateral has always been the quiet plumbing of capital markets: essential, rarely glamorous, and until recently, remarkably resistant to change. That is now shifting fast.

item.title: The Connective Tissue of Digital Finance
item.description: This whitepaper explores the next frontier of digital asset markets and what it will take to bring them to institutional scale. Read more.

item.title: How Sovereign Platforms Build Enduring Enterprises
item.description: Sovereign wealth funds are increasingly transforming from investors into enterprise builders, creating and scaling integrated platforms that combine strong governance, operational excellence and disciplined capital management to drive sustainable growth.

item.title: The World Rewired
item.description: In our February 2026 report Supply Chain Financing: Durable Global Trade in the Age of AI, we found that global supply chains had been resilient despite geopolitical pressures. Six months later, we use the most recent data on trade and foreign direct investment (FDI) flows to see whether global trade remains robust.

item.title: Eucalyptus Grove Grand Opening Event
item.description: Citi supported the grand opening of Eucalyptus Grove, a 69-unit affordable housing community in Burlingame, CA, providing critical, stable homes for low-income families, essential workers and veterans. Read more.

item.title: LatAm Poised for Take-Off
item.description: Latin America is entering one of its most favorable environments in years, with both external and domestic conditions supporting a potential acceleration in growth. We see the opportunity as significant, but think lasting success will depend on reforms, execution, and policy consistency. A new Must C report from Citi Research looks at the opportunities and what’s needed for lasting success.

item.title: Valley Vista Groundbreaking Event
item.description: Citi is enabling the development of Valley Vista Apartments, an 80-unit affordable housing project in Clearlake, CA, using innovative modular construction. Read more.

item.title: AI in the Digital Economy - From Experimentation to Global Deployment
item.description: Artificial intelligence is entering a new phase. While the past few years have been defined by experimentation, organizations are now focused on the challenge of deploying AI at scale and embedding it into core business operations. In AI in the Digital Economy: From Experimentation to Global Deployment, Citi Institute combines proprietary survey data with perspectives from industry leaders to examine how AI adoption is evolving across regions and sectors.

item.title: Shorter Cycles, Higher Stakes: Corporate Actions in a T+1 World
item.description: T+1 is set to roll out across most markets in Europe on October 11, 2027, and will touch almost every aspect of the post-trade value chain from allocations, matching and confirmations through to clearing and settlement. Corporate actions will not be spared. As the deadline for compliance draws closer, the industry is working hard to align its corporate action practices with the shorter settlement cycle.

item.title: Capital Market Harmonization: The EU's Market Integration and Supervision Package
item.description: Over a decade in the making, the journey toward fully integrated EU capital markets began with the Capital Markets Union Action Plan in 2015. Despite significant legislative progress, fragmentation, regulatory divergence, and cross-border barriers have persisted. Renewed calls for action followed in 2019, 2020, 2023, and 2024 — culminating in the launch of the Savings and Investments Union (SIU) in March 2025 and the EU’s Market Integration and Supervision Package (EU MISP) in December 2025 (which is a cornerstone of the SIU).

item.title: Where Can We Take You? Italy
item.description: As part of its ambitious ‘Innovate for Growth 2027’ strategy, Euronext is overhauling its entire post-trade operating model, a move that will have major ramifications for Italy and other European markets. In the latest edition of our “Where Can We Take You” series, Marcello Topa, Head of Global Advocacy for Investor Services at Citi, sits down with Donatella Fronza, Italy Custody Head, to discuss Euronext’s reform plans and what they mean for Italy.

item.title: Citi México: el fraude BEC y la defensa de su empresa
item.description: BEC fraud is a highly sophisticated cyber threat that exploits the trust and internal processes of companies. Learn more about how to spot them.

item.title: Citi México: lo que debes saber para protegerte de los fraudes con Inteligencia Artificial
item.description: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is transforming the way we work. However, like any technology, it can also be used by criminals to commit increasingly sophisticated fraud. Learn more.

item.title: Emerging Markets Economic Outlook & Strategy: Artificial Intelligence and the EM Growth Divide
item.description: A new Citi Research report considers the possibility of an emerging-markets growth divide in the scramble for benefits from AI. There are only a few potential emerging-markets winners in the U.S.-led AI capex cycle, and if the 1990s IT revolution is any guide, future productivity gains could accrue more to users than producers. Here too, emerging markets look relatively disadvantaged vs. developed ones.

item.title: Agentic Commerce: A New Chapter for Instant Payments
item.description: As agentic commerce emerges, AI-powered agents making purchases on behalf of consumers will require payment rails built for machine-native transactions. Instant payments are uniquely equipped to meet this demand, providing the speed, finality, and data-rich settlement needed to power this new era of e-commerce.

item.title: From Challenge to Capital: A Modern SME's Guide to Navigating the $2.5 Trillion Trade Finance Gap
item.description: Navigating the complexities of global trade can be challenging, especially when it comes to securing the necessary financing to pay suppliers and fulfill orders. Our latest guide explores how small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) can successfully bridge the staggering $2.5 trillion trade finance gap and unlock new opportunities for growth.

item.title: Midyear 2026 Outlook: Resilience, AI, and Evolving Market Dynamics
item.description: Citi Research's Midyear 2026 Outlook highlights a resilient global economy, moderating inflation, and continued expansion despite geopolitical uncertainty. The AI investment cycle remains a key driver of earnings, capital spending, and market performance, while investors navigate evolving monetary policy, supply-chain risks, and shifting opportunities across asset classes.

item.title: Revolutionizing Trade: From Paper to Real-Time Data – And the Potential of Smart Contracts
item.description: In today's dynamic global trade environment paper-based processes create costly delays and inefficiencies hindering supply chain resilience. Discover how the shift to real-time data and smart contracts is poised to transform trade finance.

item.title: The Next Frontier: From Cost Center to Alpha Engine
item.description: This article, featuring Eric Ilardi, Global Head of Collateral Management, Investor Services, emphasizes that in an era of volatile markets and stringent regulations, a robust and automated collateral management strategy is critical for senior executive management to mitigate risk, ensure regulatory compliance, optimize liquidity, and drive alpha generation.

item.title: Digital Postcard from Cannes ’26: Advertising Enters the Agentic Era Amid a Relatively Healthy Ad Environment
item.description: A new Citi Research report explores key takeaways from Cannes, including thoughts on the benefits of AI and agents and the growing importance of data, commerce, and brand visibility as the web evolves from queries to quests.

item.title: China Second-Half Outlook: AI Supercycle Cuts Into the K-Shaped Economy
item.description: AI is now front and center in China’s K-shaped economy, further powering exports, production and the new economy even as AI-driven job displacement weighs on consumer confidence and the significant AI buildout risks crowding out old-economy investment. A new Citi Research report explores this divergence and what may lie ahead.

item.title: Overcoming Gridlock 2.0 — Solving Power Bottlenecks to Drive AI & Energy Security
item.description: The work to expand global power grids appears unable to keep pace with strong demand and supply growth, constrained by supply-chain challenges and many regions' permitting frameworks. A new Must C report from Citi Research explores solutions that could ease grid constraints and accelerate AI deployment and energy-security transitions.

item.title: Turmoil in the Middle East: Implications for Supply Chains
item.description: While the U.S.-Iran interim deal has eased some key headwinds for the global economy, it’s too early to say that the risks and challenges are entirely behind us. As we explore in a new Macro-to-Micro report, damage has been done to productive infrastructure in the Middle East, and global supply chains are likely to see challenges linger.

item.title: Citi México: Protección contra robo y suplantación de identidad
item.description: With the increasing sophistication of cyber threats, it's essential that you are prepared for risks such as institutional identity theft and identity phishing. Read more.

item.title: Citi México: Sitios y apps falsas, descarga solo de fuentes oficiales
item.description: In an increasingly sophisticated digital environment, cybercriminals have perfected their methods for deceiving users. Read more.

item.title: Energy South America: The Next Frontier
item.description: South America's energy sector is undergoing a decisive transformation as countries across the region expand investment across renewables, traditional fuels and transitional energy sources — navigating a complex global backdrop shaped by geopolitical conflict, Middle East supply chain disruptions and rising inflationary pressures. Against this backdrop, treasury and finance leaders across the region are intensifying focus on liquidity management, real-time treasury visibility, trade finance and working capital solutions, as well as digital transformation and AI-enabled automation to support operational resilience and business continuity. Citi is positioned as a core banking partner for Energy, Power and Chemicals clients in South America. As these clients invest in critical infrastructure and the energy transition, Citi offers an integrated suite of treasury, trade and liquidity capabilities, deep local market presence and a global network to help clients confidently navigate volatility, sanctions complexity and supply chain disruption.

item.title: Where Can We Take You? Chile
item.description: Eager to attract more global investment, Chile is not only doubling down on nuam, a regional stock exchange integration initiative, but also modernizing its post-trade processes. Marcello Topa, Global Head of Advocacy Investor Services at Citi, speaks to Vanessa Ringwald, Securities Services Head at Banco de Chile – a long-standing partner and majority-controlled institution in Citi’s network – about Chile’s packed market reform agenda.

item.title: Upping the Innovation Game in the Asset Management Industry
item.description: The asset management industry navigates a paradox: robust growth amidst declining profitability and intense fee compression. This environment mandates strategic innovation to transform operating models and unlock new value. In a new research report, Upping the Innovation Game in the Asset Management Industry, Citi and CREATE-Research have released findings offering a comprehensive view of the focus on innovation to reshape the global asset management industry. The report draws insights from 221 asset managers across public and private markets from 26 countries, managing a total of US$34.8 trillion in assets under management and features 40 interviews with senior executives from a cross-section of the survey respondents.

item.title: Beyond T+1: Charting the Transformation of Europe’s Post-Trade Landscape
item.description: Europe’s capital market infrastructure currently exists as an array of often unconnected trading venues, clearing houses, and settlement systems. Our recent Reimagining European Capital Markets Report paints a nuanced picture of this landscape. The analysis shows that while many feel progress has been made, only 7% of market participants consider Europe’s post-trade environment to be highly harmonized. Instead, a significant 63% view the landscape as moderately harmonized but still characterized by critical gaps in regulation and operational consistency. This disjointedness has direct implications for capital formation, liquidity, and overall costs.

item.title: Serving the Always-On Investor: A Payments Playbook for Broker-Dealers
item.description: The speed and efficiency of money movement have become critical differentiators for broker-dealers navigating a landscape shaped by the always-on investor. Our latest article serves as a playbook on leveraging instant payments to meet modern client demands, manage liquidity, and secure a competitive edge.

item.title: Adam Smith Awards Asia 2025: ZTE
The Boardroom’s New Mandate
item.description: The corporate conversation around artificial intelligence has moved on. The early focus on generative AI – tools that draft text, generate images and summarize documents – has given way to agentic AI managing business workflows autonomously. Agentic AI systems can now approve transactions, manage supply chains and resolve customer issues, often with little human oversight.

item.title: T2S vs. Non-T2S: Europe's Two-Speed Race to T+1
item.description: While Europe's move to T+1 settlement by 2027 promises greater efficiency, the path is fractured. The continent's division between TARGET2Securities (T2S) and non-T2S markets creates a complex landscape of diverse challenges and shared struggles. To date, adoption of T2S has been mixed - 24 CSDs in Europe are settling their trades using T2S, 1 but a number of financial market infrastructures (FMIs) remain outside of it.

item.title: Agenticism, Beyond the Transaction
item.description: The era of AI-driven autonomous transactions is approaching, promising unmatched efficiency but also new challenges for finance functions. Our latest article explores the rise of agentic commerce and the steps to prepare for a machine-driven payments future.

item.title: The Strategic Value of Simplified Cross-Border Payments
item.description: For companies expanding their international footprint, managing multiple currency accounts and manual workflows creates complexity and unnecessary costs. A simplified, single-account solution for cross-border payments provides a robust foundation for scalable growth and a competitive advantage in the global marketplace.

item.title: Tokenization 2030
item.description: The tokenization of financial assets – the representation of securities as digital tokens on blockchain infrastructure – is moving from pilot stage toward operational deployment. After years of slow progress held back by regulatory uncertainty, fragmented infrastructure and the absence of on-chain settlement money, adoption is now accelerating.

item.title: Citi México: Vishing y Spoofing protégete de llamadas fraudulentas
item.description: One of the most common methods of fraud today is vishing, a deception technique that uses phone calls to obtain confidential information. Learn more about how it works and how to protect yourself.

item.title: Citi México: protégete durante el gran torneo de fútbol
item.description: The great 2026 soccer tournament will fill Mexico, the United States and Canada with excitement. But just as the stadiums fill with fans, the digital world fills with malicious people who will use the soccer fever to try to deceive you.

item.title: Citi México: prevención de fraude de clientes en situación de vulnerabilidad
item.description: At Citi Mexico, our priority is for you to receive the best service and the protection of your data. We've prepared some points to warn you about the fraud risks to which you could be exposed.

item.title: UCITS ETFs: Building the Operating Model that Wins
item.description: The UCITS Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) market presents a compelling and expanding opportunity for asset managers. However, entry is complex, and success is far from guaranteed. For some, ETFs are a strategic imperative, reflecting a structural shift in how investment strategies are delivered. For others, they serve as a tactical response to changing client preferences or increasing competitive pressure.

item.title: India’s Trust-Powered Ascent
item.description: Ahead of Citi’s upcoming India Conference, we spoke with K. Balasubramanian, Citi’s Chief Country Officer for India, about the forces driving India’s rise, the role of technology and capital in shaping its future and how Citi is supporting the country’s economic transformation.

item.title: MEA Treasury: A shift in how transformation is delivered
item.description: Corporate treasury functions across the Middle East and Africa (MEA) are entering a decisive phase of transformation. Faced with volatile markets, fragmented banking ecosystems, and increasing pressure to support strategic decision-making, while also operating within economies shaped by strong commodity flows and rapidly evolving financial ecosystems, treasurers are being asked to do more than ever before.

item.title: T+1 Europe: The Next Big Test for Global FX Operations
item.description: While the T+1 settlement cycle is now a reality in North America, firms cannot afford to be complacent about its looming introduction across European markets – namely the European Union (EU), the European Economic Area (EEA), the UK and Switzerland. Scheduled for October 11, 2027, this transition is expected to have an even greater impact on the industry's FX processes than the North American roll-out. That FX operations were so resilient during North America’s T+1 transition was because financial institutions put lots of time and effort into preparing and testing their systems ahead of the deadline. If the move to T+1 in Europe is to be as frictionless for FX markets as it was in North America, a similar strategy will be required.

item.title: Where Can We Take You? Nigeria
item.description: Nigeria’s capital markets are in a period of rapid transformation, marked by a continuous drive for reform. From shortening settlement cycles to extending trading hours, the market’s momentum is palpable. In this latest edition of our “Where Can We Take You” series, Marcello Topa, Head of Global Advocacy for Investor Services at Citi, speaks to Masha Maharaj, Sub-Saharan Africa Custody Head at Citi, to unpack these upcoming changes.

item.title: Adam Smith Awards Asia 2025: Citi and Alibaba.com Pay
item.description: Citi and Alibaba.com Pay collaborate to develop AI Smart Hub to empower Alibaba.com merchants.

item.title: Bridging the 24/7 Divide
item.description: Modern life operates at the speed of thought. In a 24/7 and always-on digital economy, individuals command global services with a single tap, ordering goods at midnight, streaming a movie, paying a friend, and communicating across time zones without friction. Technology has redefined our lives, business and society. Many of the architectures, practices and processes that underpin commerce, trade, securities and other critical financial interactions, however, are still playing catch up and are constrained by legacy infrastructure.

item.title: AI in the Family Office
item.description: Family offices have reached a crucial turning point in their adoption of artificial intelligence. In contrast to institutional investors, their AI journey is shaped by the need for privacy and a mandate to manage both institutional-grade investments and deeply personal family affairs.

item.title: Working Capital’s Role in Food
item.description: The global food sector faces unprecedented challenges from high inflation, supply chain fragility, and evolving consumer demands, making disciplined working capital management more critical than ever. This analysis highlights how strategic approaches to inventory management, payables, and receivables can unlock essential liquidity, protect margins, and mitigate risks for food companies. By prioritizing efficient working capital practices, businesses can not only navigate current volatilities but also secure a competitive advantage and foster sustainable growth in a dynamic global market.

item.title: Citi México: Phishing y correos falsos: no caigas en la trampa
item.description: One of the most common scams is phishing, a technique used by criminals to deceive users and steal personal or financial information through fake emails. Learn more.

item.description: In the digital world, your password is much more than a combination of letters and numbers: it is the first line of defense to protect your financial and personal information.

item.description: A new Citi Research report looks at persistent geopolitical headwinds, leading us to trim our 2026 global-growth expectations and raise our headline-inflation forecast. But we see our projections as provisional and are prepared to revise.

item.title: ETFs in APAC: A Force to be Reckoned With
item.description: The Asia-Pacific ETF market is experiencing unprecedented growth and transformation, driven by innovative product development and dynamic regulatory changes. This evolving landscape presents both significant opportunities and complex challenges for asset managers worldwide.

item.title: Ecosystem Convergence in Trade Finance: Building an Integrated Future for Global Corporates
item.description: Global trade finance continues to be challenged by fragmented platforms, data silos, and paper heavy processes that limit visibility and slow decision making. This article explores how ecosystem convergence is reshaping trade finance by connecting systems, standardizing data, and enabling interoperability across banks, corporates, and logistics partners. It examines the role of technologies such as APIs, digital identity, smart contracts, and AI in driving automation, transparency, and resilience. The article also highlights how regulatory momentum and industry collaboration are accelerating the shift toward a more integrated, data driven global trade ecosystem and how Citi is helping clients navigate this transformation.

item.title: Counting Down to T+1 Across European Markets
item.description: The countdown to T+1 in Europe has officially shifted from a future concept to an urgent strategic priority.

item.title: AI Transition: Survey Findings Suggest Tipping Point Is Near
item.description: A new Citi Research report suggests that a tipping point is near for AI adoption in China. Our Innovation Lab survey finds AI adoption is widespread but shallow — but once the tipping point is reached, we see potential labor-market impacts and increased momentum for AI governance.

item.title: Where Can We Take You? Japan
item.description: In this latest edition of our “Where Can We Take You?” series, Marcello Topa, Head of Global Advocacy for Investor Services at Citi, talks to Jirawatana Chaitantipongse (Eddie), Japan Custody Head at Citi, about some of the post-trade reforms shaping the local market.

item.title: Asia's Energy Market: Trends, Transformation and Treasury Best Practices
item.description: Asia's energy market is undergoing a significant transformation, driven by a long-term shift away from fossil fuels toward renewables and clean energy, alongside short-term volatility stemming from geopolitical developments and the impact of U.S. tariffs. While Southeast Asia has historically relied on coal, oil and gas for approximately 83% of its energy needs, the share of renewables in the region's energy mix has more than doubled since 2000, supported by growing investment in Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and complementary technologies. Liquefied natural gas (LNG) is playing a key transitional role, with many Asian nations now committing to purchase more U.S. LNG as part of evolving trade negotiations. Against this backdrop of rising energy demand — further accelerated by the growth of AI-driven data centers — energy companies face increasingly complex financing and liquidity challenges. Citi Services supports over 900 energy clients globally with a comprehensive suite of treasury solutions, including Import Letters of Credit, Export Credit Agency financing, Supply Chain Finance, Trade Receivables Finance and Citi® Token Services, helping clients manage working capital, optimize liquidity and navigate the risks and opportunities of Asia's rapidly evolving energy landscape.

item.title: Agentic AI and the Future of Risk Decision-Making
item.description: Financial institutions are not short of data or frameworks, but risk decision-making can be fragmented, inconsistent and hard to scale. How do risk managers ensure that decisions are applied consistently and lessons are not lost over time? For this article, Citi Institute collaborated with colleagues in Citi's Risk teams to hear about their everyday experiences and explore how agentic AI could help bridge the gap between policy and practice.

item.title: Turmoil in the Middle East: Could Resilience Again Prevail?
item.description: A new Citi Research report explores a severe geopolitical scenario involving a sustained disruption in the Strait of Hormuz, and asks whether the global resilience we've seen in recent years could again prevail. While the resulting headwinds would be significant, our analysis suggests the global economy has more ways to absorb the shock than in past oil disruptions.

item.title: Rebuilding Ukraine
item.description: This Citi Institute report examines how private investment can contribute through foreign direct investment (FDI), venture capital, public-private partnerships and co-investment with international financial institutions (IFIs).

item.title: Navigating the Economic and Regulatory Landscape in 2026: Opportunities and Challenges in Asia Pacific
item.description: 2026 looks to be the year where global financial services regulation begins to pivot.

item.title: Sizing the ETF Opportunity: Active ETFs Move to Center Stage
item.description: For analysts, nothing is more satisfying than raising long-term forecasts that had once seemed aggressive, if not unattainable. That’s where we find ourselves today with U.S. Exchange-Traded Funds’ assets under management. Citi Research explores U.S. ETFs’ more mature growth phase in this new Must C report.

item.title: An Era of Accelerated Change: Redefining Treasury for Consumer and Healthcare Companies
item.description: Artificial intelligence and digital technologies are transforming treasury functions across the healthcare, consumer, and wellness sectors, impacting revenue, costs, and liquidity. Read more.

Where Can We Take You? Singapore
item.description: In this latest edition of our “Where Can We Take You?” series, Marcello Topa, Head of Global Advocacy for Investor Services at Citi, talks to Lai Chun Gan, Singapore Custody Head at Citi, about Singapore’s market transformation.

item.title: Adopting the Real-Time Mindset: A Competitive Advantage in an "Always-On" World
item.description: In an era defined by rapid change and increasing data velocity, our clients are actively seeking strategies to move beyond reactive decision-making. Read more.

item.title: Middle East Turmoil: Unsettled and Unsettling
item.description: An energy-led supply shock has driven a relatively muted emerging-markets macro impact assessment. A new Citi Research report explores why the blow has been less than expected, at least so far, and looks at economies that could be more and less affected.

item.title: Turmoil in the Middle East: Headwinds for the Global Economy
item.description: The Middle East conflict offers significant downside risks for the global economy. While Citi Research’s baseline 2026 growth forecast is only a bit lower than in February, more severe scenarios remain possible. Such outcomes could drag global growth below 2%, push headline inflation above 4%, and stoke recession risks.

item.title: The Digital Revolution in Insurance: An Industry Reshaped by D2C
item.description: The insurance industry is undergoing a significant digital transformation, shifting from traditional agent-led sales to a direct-to-consumer (D2C) model. Read more.

item.title: How AI Will Transform Your Supply Chain and Receivables Finance Strategy
item.description: What if your financial strategies could predict the future, not just react to the past? In today's dynamic global economy, optimizing working capital and effectively managing financial risk are paramount for business resilience. This article reveals how artificial intelligence is transforming supply chain and receivables finance, offering strategic advantages for resilience and growth.

item.title: Citi Mexico Expectations Survey (March 20, 2026)
Post Quantum Migration and the Path to Resilient Blockchains
item.description: In our last post, Managing the Quantum Threat to Blockchains, we outlined why quantum computing poses a long term risk to today’s cryptography. Here, Citi Institute’s Ronit Ghose continues the conversation with Thomas Coratger, Lead of the Post Quantum Team at the Ethereum Foundation. They discuss how a practical migration could unfold, what timelines are realistic and how responsibilities might be divided up.

item.title: Managing The Quantum Threat to Blockchains
item.description: No longer just theoretical, quantum computers pose important questions for blockchains. In our report, Citi: Quantum Threat - The Trillion-Dollar Security Race Is On, we highlight how rapid advances in hardware, improved post-quantum cryptography (PQC) standards and rising regulatory demands are making quantum preparedness a priority.

item.title: Supercharged
item.description: Technology has always had the power to reshape societies. But the current wave of disruption – driven by advances in artificial intelligence – is unfolding at dizzying pace and on an unprecedented scale. Unlike previous technological revolutions, which generally took decades, AI is firing change across industries, institutions and societies in real time.
